nodes.label: AnomalySafetyScale
nodes.rationale: March step count is also scaled by AnomalySafetyScale (camera translation / look). Do not globally floor that scale.

nodes.label: IsolatedSub Compose
nodes.rationale: The shader writes positive energy-to-remove; Anomaly merges max(LBuffer.rgb - src.rgb, 0) so the result is format-safe on Keen R11G11B10_Float LBuffer.

nodes.label: Contact March Quality Presets
nodes.rationale: Quality presets change contact march uniforms (steps, max lights, ray distance), not shader permutations.

nodes.label: Anomaly Owns Shared Rendering Gaps
nodes.rationale: When this pack invents lighting, IsolatedMix energy, or march LOD that the next Anomaly shader will also need, file it on Anomaly Docs/Extensibility.md Slice AI and wiki/Framework-gaps.md rather than leaving it pack-private.

nodes.label: Rich HUD Config Save Rule
nodes.rationale: Rich HUD sliders must not serialize or write config on every tick; ControlChanged fires continuously and per-tick XmlSerializer I/O can queue GPU work until a later device hang.

nodes.label: Contact Hits Closer Occluders Only
nodes.rationale: Contact ray-marches this-frame linearDepth toward the light and hits only occluders closer to the camera than the receiver, so the floor does not self-shadow.

nodes.label: IsolatedSub Format-Safe Merge
nodes.rationale: IsolatedSub writes positive energy-to-remove and Anomaly merges max(LBuffer.rgb - src.rgb, 0) so subtraction stays format-safe on Keen R11G11B10_Float LBuffer.

nodes.label: Light-View Shadows Unseen Occluders
nodes.rationale: Light-view maps are the only layer that shadows occluders the camera has never seen; Anomaly rasterizes actor AABBs into pointShadowAtlas, not Keen meshes.

nodes.label: Normal Pulsar Plugin Not Hidden
nodes.rationale: This is a normal Pulsar plugin with DependencyIds pointing at Anomaly — not a Hidden plugin.

nodes.label: Darken Only Point-Light Energy
nodes.rationale: Vanilla SE only shadows the sun (CSM) and up to four spots; tiled point lights are unshadowed. This pack darkens only that point-light energy at AfterLighting so ambient, sun, spots, and emissive stay untouched.

nodes.label: Plugin Config Control Catalog
nodes.rationale: The screenshot is a catalog demo, not a live pack settings page: each widget type (bool, int, float, string, enum, RGB, RGBA, keybind, action) is shown once so authors can copy the dialog pattern.
